title: Epochs, Batches, and Learning Rates knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Batch size” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.answer_key: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.explanation: Batch size: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Number of epochs”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm gradients were computed before stepping, gradients are cleared at the intended time, and validation does not update parameters.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: confirm gradients were computed before stepping, gradients are cleared at the intended time, and validation does not update parameters.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm gradients were computed before stepping, gradients are cleared at the intended time, and validation does not update parameters.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Learning-rate selection”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not call optimizer.step() before backward(), or evaluate validation data with the training-update path.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not call optimizer.step() before backward(), or evaluate validation data with the training-update path.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not call optimizer.step() before backward(), or evaluate validation data with the training-update path.
